# Chessed — Unbounded Platform Revelation

The Awtsmoos renews every instant; Awtsmoos.com should reveal one coherent product civilization rather than scattered pages.

## Boundless Target
- One canonical product graph for routes, commerce, credits, SEO, analytics, tests, docs, recommendations, workflows, ownership, and lifecycle.
- Every eligible app/game receives truthful Peruta offers and meaningful credit-capable actions.
- Apps/Games hubs become polished, mobile-first marketplaces with live server testimony instead of static commerce claims.
- Shared foundation owns wallet chip, commerce surface, catalog merchandising, account state, failure recovery, accessibility, safe areas, and reduced motion.
- Paid-action SDK eventually provides quote, consume/reserve, idempotency, receipt, rollback, insufficient-funds recovery, and preserved task context.
- Cross-app workflows, recents, favorites, deep links, product pages, PWA, SEO, screenshots, release automation, analytics, observability, enterprise, and creator layers follow from the product graph.

## Seven Always-On Workstreams
1. Product identity truth.
2. Commerce truth.
3. Marketplace merchandising.
4. Mobile/a11y polish.
5. Adoption/readiness tooling.
6. Feature-level credit use.
7. Verification/observability/handoff.
